title: What Happens When AI Makes Every Decision #artificialintelligence #technology #future #diaryofaceo
description:
As artificial intelligence becomes more powerful, some experts believe we may be approaching a future where AI systems make increasingly important decisions.

In this clip from The Diary of a CEO, the discussion explores superintelligence, competition between nations, and the long-term consequences of relying on AI.

The question isn't whether AI will get smarter.

The question is what happens when it does.
